access.status: Design targets, not OEM minima or demonstrated class compliance

removal.location: Centred above each machinery reservation; continuity through decks and lifting path NOT modelled or verified

inRoomOverhaul.hold: No manufacturer piston/liner extraction envelope; nominal current overhead cannot be declared sufficient

shaft.status: Pure torsion screen only. No fatigue, bending, keyway, class diameter, bearing, alignment or torsional vibration approval.

startAir.status: Isothermal usable free-air estimate only; simultaneous start requirements and compressor recovery not proven

shafts.status: Pure torsion screen only. No fatigue, bending, keyway, class diameter, bearing, alignment or torsional vibration approval.
